Ethiopia set a record when it planted an estimated 350 million trees in one day in 2019. When it comes to planting trees, though, simply scattering millions of seeds isn’t going to do the trick, as there are all sorts of factors that can prevent a seed from germinating and growing into a full-fledged tree.
